messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T

At 16¢ the Magic Miner 40T runs about 650W at 40 TH/s — roughly $75 a month in power. The Harlo B30 sits near 400W for 30 TH/s, about $46 a month. Both are quiet desktop towers, ~50 dB.

The H15 Dual you're on hasn't opened for orders yet, no drop date announced. Of the two you can order today, the 40T is the best value per terahash — $799, Batch 6, ships Nov 14. The B30 is $899, ships Nov 30.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
